name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.wittPairing_constantAt_and_thirdPairing
summary: Both identities hold on pure tensors.

steps.claim: (1) on pure tensors: B(letterProj(1 ⊗ 1), w) = letterProj(w) (wittPairing_letterProj_left);
(2) on pure tensors in n, w, y: unfold thirdPairing ((λ, o), t) ↦ (p^m λ + oψ)(t) and modPairing; the term p^m λ(t) vanishes modulo p^m.
steps.lean:
diagTensor_induction fun _ _ ↦ diagTensor_induction fun _ _ ↦ diagTensor_induction
  (by simp [thirdPairing, modPairing,
  mul_assoc, -nsmul_eq_mul]; simp [← map_nsmul, ↓nsmul_quot_eq_zero])⟩
